```{r}
my_tree <- read.tree("/Users/yjkang/Desktop/NIE_BigData/wetland_birds/data/Wetland_2006_2023/bird_tree.tre")

# 2. Create the Community Matrix (Rows = Site_Year, Cols = Species)
comm_matrix <- table(paste(df$Wetland_Name, df$Year, sep="_"), df$Scientific_Name)
comm_matrix <- as.data.frame.matrix(comm_matrix)

# remove BirdTree.org tip labels with underscores (e.g., "Anas_platyrhynchos"). 
colnames(comm_matrix) <- gsub(" ", "_", colnames(comm_matrix))

# Align Tree and the Matrix 
# Any spelling mismatches will be dropped from both the tree and the matrix.
matched_data <- match.phylo.comm(my_tree, comm_matrix)
clean_tree <- matched_data$phy
clean_comm_matrix <- matched_data$comm

# evolutionary distance matrix (in Millions of Years)
phylo_dist_matrix <- cophenetic(clean_tree)
#write.tree(mcc_tree, file = "/Users/yjkang/Desktop/NIE_BigData/wetland_birds/data/Wetland_2006_2023/bird_tree.tre")
```

```{r}
ses_mpd_out <- ses.mpd(clean_comm_matrix, phylo_dist_matrix, null.model = "taxa.labels", abundance.weighted = FALSE, runs = 999)
```

```{r}
  rename(Year = 조사년도, Wetland_KR = 습지명) %>%
  select(Wetland_KR, Latitude, Longitude) %>%
  distinct(Wetland_KR, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Latitude), !is.na(Longitude))

birds_df <- birds_df %>%
  mutate(Wetland_KR = sapply(strsplit(as.character(Site_Year), "_"), `[`, 1)) %>%
  left_join(coords_df, by = "Wetland_KR")
```

```{r}
#combine climate variables and species diversity
library(ncdf4)

nc_files <- list(
  "Annual Precipitation (mm)" = "강수량_MKPRISMv21_skorea_RN_gridraw_yearly_2000_2019.nc",
  "Maximum Dry Spell Length (days)" = "최대무강수지속기간_MKPRISMv21_skorea_CDD_gridraw_yearly_2000_2019.nc",
  "Heatwave Days (days)" = "폭염일수_MKPRISMv21_skorea_HW33_gridraw_yearly_2000_2019.nc",
  "Average Wind Speed (m/s)" = "풍속_MKPRISMv21_skorea_WS_gridraw_yearly_2000_2019.nc",
  "Coldwave Days (days)" = "한파일수_MKPRISMv21_skorea_CWm12_gridraw_yearly_2000_2019.nc"
)

extract_climate_data <- function(df, max_radius = 15) {
  # Define the fill value used in MK-PRISM (usually -9990)
  FILL_VALUE_THRESHOLD <- -9000 

  for (var_name in names(nc_files)) {
    filename <- nc_files[[var_name]]
    df[[var_name]] <- NA
    
    if (!file.exists(filename)) {
      message(paste("File not found, skipping:", filename))
      next
    }

    nc_data <- nc_open(filename)
    lats <- ncvar_get(nc_data, "latitude")
    lons <- ncvar_get(nc_data, "longitude")
    var_id <- names(nc_data$var)[1] 
    
    time_units <- ncatt_get(nc_data, "time", "units")$value
    base_year <- ifelse(grepl("2014", time_units), 2014, 2000)
    
    message(paste("Extracting variable:", var_name))

    for (i in 1:nrow(df)) {
      target_lat <- df$Latitude[i]
      target_lon <- df$Longitude[i]
      target_year <- df$Year[i]
      
      if (is.na(target_lat) || is.na(target_lon) || is.na(target_year)) next
      
      # 1. Find the initial mathematically closest pixel
      lat_idx <- which.min(abs(lats - target_lat))
      lon_idx <- which.min(abs(lons - target_lon))
      time_idx <- (target_year - base_year) + 1

      # Ensure year is within NetCDF bounds
      if (time_idx >= 1 && time_idx <= nc_data$dim$time$len) {
        
        found_valid <- FALSE
        
        # 2. Start Buffered Search (Radius 0 to max_radius)
        # Radius 0 is the exact point. Radius 1 is a 3x3 grid, etc.
        for (r in 0:max_radius) {
          # Define window boundaries
          start_lon <- max(1, lon_idx - r)
          start_lat <- max(1, lat_idx - r)
          # Determine width/height of the window
          count_lon <- min(nc_data$dim$longitude$len - start_lon + 1, (2 * r) + 1)
          count_lat <- min(nc_data$dim$latitude$len - start_lat + 1, (2 * r) + 1)
          # Extract the window/block for that specific time index
          window_data <- ncvar_get(nc_data, varid = var_id, 
                                   start = c(start_lon, start_lat, time_idx), 
                                   count = c(count_lon, count_lat, 1))
          # Filter for valid land values (ignoring fill values like -9990)
          valid_values <- window_data[window_data > FILL_VALUE_THRESHOLD]
          if (length(valid_values) > 0) {
            # Use the average of valid points found at the closest possible radius
            df[[var_name]][i] <- mean(valid_values, na.rm = TRUE)
            found_valid <- TRUE
            break # Exit the radius loop once data is found
          }
        }
        if (!found_valid) {
          message(paste("No valid land data within", max_radius, "pixels for:", df$Wetland_KR[i], "in", target_year))
        }
      }
    }
    nc_close(nc_data)
  }
  return(df)
}

# Run the extraction (this might take a few moments depending on dataset size)
birds_final <- extract_climate_data(birds_df)
# Drop temporary merge column
birds_final <- birds_final %>% select(-Wetland_KR)

# Export curated files
#write_csv(plants_final, "plants_phylo_traj_climate_fullnames_R.csv")
#write_csv(birds_final, "bird_phylo_traj_climate_fullnames_R.csv")
```

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(car)

rename_map <- c(
  "sDTN" = "Spring_Mean_DTN",
  "AP" = "Annual.Precipitation..mm.", 
  "Dry" = "Maximum.Dry.Spell.Length..days.", 
  "Heatw" = "Heatwave.Days..days.", #"Heatwave Days (days)",
  "WS" = "Average.Wind.Speed..m.s.", #"Average Wind Speed (m/s)",
  "Coldw" = "Coldwave.Days..days.", #"Coldwave Days (days)",
  "WTemp" = "Mean_Water_Temp",	
  "pH" = "Mean_pH",	
  "BOD" = "Mean_BOD",	
  "sDO" = "Summer_Min_DO"	)

#Filtering out dropped vars, omitting NAs, and scaling
vars_to_keep <- names(rename_map)

prepare_data <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    rename(any_of(rename_map)) %>%
    select(SES_MPD, Wetland, all_of(vars_to_keep)) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(.)) %>%  # Drop rows with NA values
    mutate(across(all_of(vars_to_keep), scale)) # Standardize (Z-score) the 7 climate variables
}

birds_clean <- prepare_data(birds_df)
```

```{r}
cat("\n=== Checking VIF for the 7 Variables ===\n")
vif_model <- lm(SES_MPD ~ sDTN+ AP+ Dry + Heatw + WS + Coldw + WTemp + pH + BOD + sDO, data = birds_clean) 
print(vif(vif_model))
# Note: Variables with a VIF > 5 are highly collinear and should be dropped before running Mixed-Effects Model

cat("\n=== BIRD LMM ===\n")
bird_lmm <- lmer(SES_MPD ~ sDTN+ AP+ Dry + Heatw + WS + Coldw + WTemp + pH + BOD + sDO + (1 | Wetland), data = birds_clean)
print(summary(bird_lmm))
```

```{r, fig.width= 8.7, fig.height=4.1, message=FALSE}
library(tidyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggpmisc)

rename_map <- c(
  "Annual Precip (mm)" = "Annual.Precipitation..mm.", 
  "Max Dry Spell (days)" = "Maximum.Dry.Spell.Length..days.", 
  "Heatwaves (days)" = "Heatwave.Days..days.", #"Heatwave Days (days)",
  "Coldwaves (days)" = "Coldwave.Days..days.", #"Coldwave Days (days)",
  "Wind Speed (m/s)" = "Average.Wind.Speed..m.s.", #"Average Wind Speed (m/s)",
  "Water Temp (°C)" = "Mean_Water_Temp",	
  "Mean Water pH" = "Mean_pH",	
  "BOD (mg/L)" = "Mean_BOD",	
  "Summer DO (mg/L)" = "Summer_Min_DO",
  "Spring DTN (mg/L)" = "Spring_Mean_DTN" )
long_names<- names(rename_map)

plot_climate_correlations <- function(df, title_prefix, point_color) {
  
  df_clean <- df %>%
    rename(any_of(rename_map)) %>%
    select(SES_MPD, all_of(long_names)) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(.)) %>%
    # Pivot the data into a "long" format, which is required for ggplot faceting
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(long_names), 
                 names_to = "Climate_Variable", 
                 values_to = "Value")
    #df_clean$Climate_Variable <- factor(df_clean$Climate_Variable, levels = long_names)
    df_clean$Climate_Variable <- gsub(" \\(", "\n\\(", df_clean$Climate_Variable)
    wrapped_levels <- gsub(" \\(", "\n\\(", long_names)
    df_clean$Climate_Variable <- factor(df_clean$Climate_Variable, levels = wrapped_levels)
  
  p <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = Value, y = SES_MPD)) +
    geom_point(color = point_color, alpha = 0.7, size = 1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))) +
    stat_correlation(use_label("R", "R.CI"), size=2.5) +
    #stat_cor(method = "pearson", label.x.npc = 0.02, label.y.npc = 0, size = 3.7) + 
    facet_wrap(~ Climate_Variable, scales = "free_x", ncol = 5, 
               labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 22)) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off")+
    labs(
      title = paste("Potential Environmental Drivers of Wetland", title_prefix ,"Diversity"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Phylogenetic Diversity (SES-MPD)"
    ) +
    theme_bw() + # Clean white background theme
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  return(p) }

bird_plot <- plot_climate_correlations(birds_df, "Bird", "dodgerblue3")
print(bird_plot)
#ggsave("/Users/yjkang/Desktop/Bird_Climate_Correlations.pdf", plot = bird_plot, width = 8.7, height = 4.1)
```

```{r, fig.height=4, fig.width=5}
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(viridis)

korea_map <- ne_states(country = "south korea", returnclass = "sf")

plants_clean_spatial <- birds_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(Longitude) & !is.na(Latitude))
plants_sf <- st_as_sf(plants_clean_spatial, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)
plants_mean_sf <- plants_sf %>%
  group_by(Wetland) %>%
  summarize(mean_SES_MPD = mean(SES_MPD, na.rm = TRUE))

p<-ggplot() +
  # Draw the base map of Korea in light grey
  geom_sf(data = korea_map, fill = "gray95", color = "gray50") +
  # Plot the wetlands, coloring them by Phylogenetic Diversity (SES_MPD)
  geom_sf(data = plants_mean_sf, aes(size = mean_SES_MPD), shape = 21,
          alpha = 0.8, fill = "dodgerblue3",color='white', stroke=0.5) +  # stroke=Thickness of the white outline
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Stopover wetland hubs on South Korean peninsula") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold") ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "Avian Diversity\n(SES-MPD)", 
    breaks = c(-3, 0, 3),                     # Which values to show
    labels = c("Clustered", "Balanced", "Diverse"), 
    limits = c(-5, 3), range = c(1,6)         # Adjust the min/max circle size
  ) 
print(p)
#ggsave("/Users/yjkang/Desktop/Bird_divers_map.pdf", plot = p, width = 5, height = 4)
```
